trello.name: Add queue depth alerting for worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Add alerting on queue depth for the entire worker fleet (not just payments), with warning threshold at 1,000 jobs and paging threshold at 5,000 jobs. Same thresholds everywhere. Kofi to implement in one pass.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic with backoff and dead-letter queue
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py, specifically the _process_with_retry function. Requirements: implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the number of retries, and on final failure send jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back (not the front of the main queue). Add tests that simulate processor 503 responses. Acceptance criteria: retry storm behavior is eliminated, failed jobs no longer re-enqueue at the front of the main queue.

trello.name: Increase and split DB connection pools for workers and API
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. In the same config file change: (1) bump the DB connection pool from the default of 20 to 100, and (2) split worker and API pools so workers do not exhaust the API's connection pool. Both parts in one change.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya (Kofi to confirm with her after the meeting). Update the payment incident runbook to: replace old Kibana links with current logging links, document the queue drain procedure Kofi improvised during Tuesday's outage, and verify escalation phone numbers are current (at least one still routes to someone who left last year).

trello.name: Automate status page updates on checkout error rate alert
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Use the status page provider's API to automatically flip the status page to 'investigating' with a template message when the checkout error rate alert fires. Start with the checkout alert; can extend to other alerts later.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a plan for a controlled chaos test of the payment processor failover, starting in staging then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. The plan must be reviewed in two weeks before any execution. Draft first, no execution until the review.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Upgrade Redis from 6.0 (security fixes ended in June) to 7.2. Note: there is a config rename and persistence defaults changed, so it requires a proper change window scheduled with the infra calendar, not a casual Friday deploy.

trello.name: Write and distribute incident timeline doc
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the incident timeline document tonight and send it out tomorrow.
